name: Gradient Map
description: Webcam-driven shader that remaps luminance to custom gradient palettes with precise control over contrast, blend, and blur.

name: Metaball2 Shader
description: Shader-based audio-reactive metaballs with presets and advanced controls.

name: Orbiter
description: 3D particle system with audio-reactive emitters orbiting in 3D space.

name: Inkdrop
description: Sound-reactive ink in water particle system with flow fields and color themes.

name: Liquid Marbling
description: WebGL fluid marbling shader with curl noise, interactive mouse drag to pull paint, and audio-reactive motion.

name: Op Art
description: Audio-reactive striped cubes and spheres with op-art patterns and orbital motion.

name: Webbing
description: Dual emitter audio visualizer with particle connections and web-like patterns.

name: Wormhole
description: 3D tunnel visualization with stars, rings, or squares. Audio-reactive camera movement.

name: Pixelated
description: Video-based particle visualizer with audio-reactive distortion. Uses camera input for pixel-based effects.

name: Big Solid
description: Audio-reactive full-screen solid color visualization with palette-based color transitions and flash effects.

name: Bauhaus
description: Rhythmic Bauhaus grid visualization with audio-reactive shapes, color sequences, and multiple themes.

name: Kaleidoscope
description: Audio-reactive webcam kaleidoscope with fractal recursion, multi-center rotation, and temporal feedback effects.

name: Camera Shake
description: Audio-reactive camera shake effect with webcam input, position/rotation shake, and color refraction.

name: Datamosh Lab
description: Audio-reactive webcam datamosh with multiple glitch modes, temporal feedback, and CRT post-processing.

name: Leaks and Lights
description: Audio-reactive light leaks and particle bursts visualization with customizable palettes, blend modes, and camera overlay.

name: Orbiting Wheels
description: Audio-reactive orbiting wheels with 3D orbit and tunnel modes, customizable color themes, and dynamic camera movement.

name: Flow
description: Audio-reactive particle fluid visualization with swirling vortices, flow dynamics, and customizable particle behavior.

name: Mandala
description: Geometric wireframes with persistent steps, then ride the post drivers for live, audio-reactive expression.

name: Big Deck
description: 3D card deck visualization with multiple layout modes, audio reactivity, and customizable lighting. Features texture-based card images.

name: Photosome
description: Ink drop visualization with audio-reactive motion and bass-triggered drops. Features fluid-like expansion curves, shape variability, and multiple blend modes.

name: Orbs
description: Instanced emissive spheres arranged as orbiting shell layers with bloom, trails, and audio reactivity. Features customizable color palettes and per-layer motion controls.

name: Video Playback
description: Local video files with playlist or single-loop modes, transitions (cut, crossfade, fade-to-black), and optional audio-reactive RGB/glitch effects. Assets listed in media/video/manifest.json.

name: Beholder
description: Surreal floating eye swarm with depth-of-field, ambient drift, saccadic gaze, and optional microphone-driven pulse.

name: Eidolon
description: Gaussian Splat performer — load .ply scans, explode and reconstruct splats with modular deformations and audio modulation.

name: Procedural Geometry
description: Audio-reactive geometric patterns featuring concentric shapes, parallel lines, waveforms, extreme width and spacing variations, turbulence, and layered procedural distortion.
